description: This file defines the CompanyStructureService class, which manages organizational subunits in a human resource management system. It provides methods for CRUD operations on subunits, retrieving subunit hierarchies, and setting organization names, utilizing DAOs and models within the system.

classes.name: CompanyStructureService
classes.description: A service class that handles operations related to company's organizational structure including subunit management, hierarchy retrieval, and organization name setting.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the DAO responsible for database operations related to company structure.

methods.name: setCompanyStructureDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO instance used by the service.

methods.name: getSubunitById
methods.description: Fetches a subunit entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: saveSubunit
methods.description: Persists a subunit entity to storage.

methods.name: addSubunit
methods.description: Adds a child subunit to a parent subunit within the hierarchy.

methods.name: deleteSubunit
methods.description: Removes a subunit and its descendants from the system.

methods.name: setOrganizationName
methods.description: Updates the root organization's name, affecting the top-level node.

methods.name: getSubunitTree
methods.description: Retrieves the entire hierarchy of subunits up to an optional depth.

methods.name: getSubunitArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of subunits excluding the root.

methods.name: getSubunitChainById
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of IDs representing the chain of subunits from a specific subunit up to the top level.
